briefs.goal: Design a mechanism for allocating eight shared workshop stations among twenty people requesting one-hour sessions.
constraints: Never allocate more than eight stations simultaneously.
Do not require payments or a permanent central operator.
Explain handling of conflicting requests and no-shows.

briefs.goal: Design a neighborhood tool-lending service that can operate from one small staffed desk for two hours each week.
constraints: Use at most one paid staff member during opening hours.
Explain how tools are returned and damage is handled.
Do not require users to own a smartphone.

briefs.goal: Design a participatory public exhibit that communicates how a local river changes over a year.
constraints: Fit within a single indoor room.
Support visitors who cannot hear spoken audio.
Explain how contributions from visitors alter the exhibit without obscuring prior contributions.
